title: {{NAME}} and the Sparkle Field Showdown
moral: When you try your best, amazing things can happen.

pages.content: {{NAME}} walked onto the most amazing soccer field he had ever seen. The grass was made of soft green sparkles. Tiny fairies flew along the goalposts holding little banners. A big orange robot was the referee. It blew a silver whistle. Teams were forming on the sparkle grass. {{NAME}} was ready to play.

pages.content: The orange robot said his name was Clank. Clank chose {{NAME}} for his team. But {{NAME}}'s team had only two players. The other team had five fairies. They were very fast and flew above the ground. "That is not fair," said {{NAME}}. Clank's eyes flickered. "You are right," he said. He gave {{NAME}}'s team three fairies too.

pages.content: The match started. {{NAME}} dribbled fast down the sparkle field. A fairy passed the ball back to him. He shot hard at the goal. The ball flew through the sparkle air. It bent around the goalkeeper and hit the back of the net. GOAL! The fairies on his team spun in the air with joy. Clank flashed his orange lights.

pages.content: The other team scored too. It was one goal each. Last chance! {{NAME}} felt nervous. His legs felt wobbly. But he took a big breath. He ran as fast as he could. He kicked the ball one more time. It sailed in slowly and crossed the line. His team had won! When you try your best, amazing things can happen.

pages.content: After the match, Clank made hot cocoa for everyone. The fairies sat on {{NAME}}'s shoulders and his head. They were all tired and happy.
